# 2016. Maximum Difference Between Increasing Elements

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maximumDifference(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(nums)
        prev_min = nums[0]
        ans = -float("inf")
        for i in range(1, n):
            ans = max(ans, nums[i] - prev_min)
            prev_min = min(prev_min, nums[i])
        if ans <= 0:
            return -1
        else:
            return ans
```
